description: Find where something was said across the user's Granola meetings: a phrase, a name, a product, a number. Searches summaries and full transcripts of synced notes and returns each matching meeting with a short excerpt around the match. Use it for 'when did we discuss X' or 'what did she say about Y'; use get_granola_notes to browse by date.

query.description: The phrase or name to find.

name: search_granola_transcripts
title: Search meeting transcripts
